LynxTestingEnv.summary.en:
A pure-JavaScript implementation of the [Lynx Spec](https://lynxjs.org/guide/spec.html),
notably the [Element PAPI](https://lynxjs.org/api/engine/element-api) and [Dual-threaded Model](https://lynxjs.org/guide/spec#dual-threaded-model) for use with Node.js.
LynxTestingEnv.summary.text:
[Lynx 规范](https://lynxjs.org/guide/spec.html)的纯 JavaScript 实现，
主要包括 [Element PAPI](https://lynxjs.org/api/engine/element-api) 和[双线程模型](https://lynxjs.org/guide/spec#dual-threaded-model)，可在 Node.js 中使用。

LynxTestingEnv.backgroundThread.summary.en: The global object for the background thread.

LynxTestingEnv.mainThread.summary.en: The global object for the main thread.

ByRoleOptions.busy.summary.en:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
busy in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-busy="true"`
ByRoleOptions.busy.summary.text:
若为 true，则仅包含查询集合中在无障碍树中被标记为
busy 的元素，即 `aria-busy="true"`

ByRoleOptions.checked.summary.en:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
checked in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-checked="true"`
ByRoleOptions.checked.summary.text:
若为 true，则仅包含查询集合中在无障碍树中被标记为
checked 的元素，即 `aria-checked="true"`

ByRoleOptions.current.summary.en: Filters elements by their `aria-current` state. `true` and `false` match `aria-current="true"` and `aria-current="false"` (as well as a missing `aria-current` attribute) respectively.
ByRoleOptions.current.summary.text: 按元素的 `aria-current` 状态进行过滤。`true` 和 `false` 分别匹配 `aria-current="true"` 和 `aria-current="false"`（以及缺少 `aria-current` 属性的情况）。

ByRoleOptions.description.summary.en: Only considers elements with the specified accessible description.
ByRoleOptions.description.summary.text: 仅考虑具有指定无障碍描述（accessible description）的元素。

ByRoleOptions.expanded.summary.en:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
expanded in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-expanded="true"`
ByRoleOptions.expanded.summary.text:
若为 true，则仅包含查询集合中在无障碍树中被标记为
expanded 的元素，即 `aria-expanded="true"`

ByRoleOptions.hidden.summary.en:
If true includes elements in the query set that are usually excluded from
the accessibility tree. `role="none"` or `role="presentation"` are included
in either case.
ByRoleOptions.hidden.summary.text:
若为 true，则在查询集合中包含通常会被排除在
无障碍树之外的元素。`role="none"` 或 `role="presentation"`
在任何情况下都会被包含。

ByRoleOptions.level.summary.en:
Includes elements with the `"heading"` role matching the indicated level,
either by the semantic HTML heading elements `<h1>-<h6>` or matching
the `aria-level` attribute.
ByRoleOptions.level.summary.text:
包含具有 `"heading"` 角色且与指定层级匹配的元素，
既可以是语义化 HTML 标题元素 `<h1>-<h6>`，也可以是匹配
`aria-level` 属性的元素。

ByRoleOptions.name.summary.en: Only considers elements with the specified accessible name.
ByRoleOptions.name.summary.text: 仅考虑具有指定无障碍名称（accessible name）的元素。

ByRoleOptions.pressed.summary.en:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
pressed in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-pressed="true"`
ByRoleOptions.pressed.summary.text:
若为 true，则仅包含查询集合中在无障碍树中被标记为
pressed 的元素，即 `aria-pressed="true"`

ByRoleOptions.queryFallbacks.summary.en:
Includes every role used in the `role` attribute
For example *ByRole('progressbar', {queryFallbacks: true})` will find <div role="meter progressbar">`.
ByRoleOptions.queryFallbacks.summary.text:
包含 `role` 属性中使用的所有角色
例如 *ByRole('progressbar', {queryFallbacks: true})` will find <div role="meter progressbar">`。

ByRoleOptions.selected.summary.en:
If true only includes elements in the query set that are marked as
selected in the accessibility tree, i.e., `aria-selected="true"`
ByRoleOptions.selected.summary.text:
若为 true，则仅包含查询集合中在无障碍树中被标记为
selected 的元素，即 `aria-selected="true"`

ByRoleOptions.suggest.summary.en: suppress suggestions for a specific query

Config.defaultIgnore.summary.en: default value for the `ignore` option in `ByText` queries
Config.defaultIgnore.summary.text: `ByText` 查询中 `ignore` 选项的默认值

Config.unstable_advanceTimersWrapper.sum.en: WARNING: `unstable` prefix means this API may change in patch and minor releases.
Config.unstable_advanceTimersWrapper.sum.text: 警告：`unstable` 前缀表示此 API 可能会在补丁版本和次版本中发生变化。

MatcherOptions.collapseWhitespace.summar.text: 请改为使用 normalizer 配合 getDefaultNormalizer

MatcherOptions.suggest.summary.en: suppress suggestions for a specific query

MatcherOptions.trim.summary.text: 请改为使用 normalizer 配合 getDefaultNormalizer

PrettyDOMOptions.filterNode.summary.en:
Given a `Node` return `false` if you wish to ignore that node in the output.
By default, ignores `<style />`, `<script />` and comment nodes.
PrettyDOMOptions.filterNode.summary.text:
给定一个 `Node`，如果希望在输出中忽略该节点，则返回 `false`。
默认会忽略 `<style />`、`<script />` 和注释节点。

RenderHookOptions.initialProps.summary.en:
The argument passed to the renderHook callback. Can be useful if you plan
to use the rerender utility to change the values passed to your hook.
RenderHookOptions.initialProps.summary.text:
传递给 renderHook 回调的参数。如果你计划
使用 rerender 工具函数来更改传递给 hook 的值，这会很有用。

RenderHookOptions.wrapper.summary.en:
Pass a React Component as the wrapper option to have it rendered around the inner element. This is most useful for creating
 reusable custom render functions for common data providers. See setup for examples.
RenderHookOptions.wrapper.summary.text:
传入一个 React 组件作为 wrapper 选项，使其渲染在内部元素的外层。这在为常见的数据提供者创建
 可复用的自定义渲染函数时最为有用。示例参见 setup。

RenderHookResult.rerender.summary.en: Triggers a re-render. The props will be passed to your renderHook callback.
RenderHookResult.rerender.summary.text: 触发一次重新渲染。props 会被传递给你的 renderHook 回调。

RenderHookResult.result.summary.en:
This is a stable reference to the latest value returned by your renderHook
callback
RenderHookResult.result.summary.text:
这是一个稳定的引用，指向 renderHook
回调最近一次返回的值

RenderHookResult.unmount.summary.en:
Unmounts the test component. This is useful for when you need to test
any cleanup your useEffects have.
RenderHookResult.unmount.summary.text:
卸载测试组件。当你需要测试
useEffect 中的清理逻辑时，这会很有用。

RenderOptions.enableBackgroundThread.sum.en:
Render your component in the background thread or not.

Note that all user code in the top level will be executed in the background thread by default. (eg. `__BACKGROUND__` is `true` in the top level)
RenderOptions.enableBackgroundThread.sum.text:
是否在后台线程中渲染组件。

注意，默认情况下所有顶层用户代码都会在后台线程中执行（例如，顶层的 `__BACKGROUND__` 为 `true`）。

RenderOptions.enableMainThread.summary.en:
Render your component in the main thread or not.

It is recommended to use this option only when you need to test the [IFR](https://lynxjs.org/zh/guide/interaction/ifr.html) behavior.
RenderOptions.enableMainThread.summary.text:
是否在主线程中渲染组件。

建议仅在需要测试 [IFR](https://lynxjs.org/zh/guide/interaction/ifr.html) 行为时使用此选项。

RenderOptions.queries.summary.en: Queries to bind. Overrides the default set from DOM Testing Library unless merged.
RenderOptions.queries.summary.text: 要绑定的查询。除非进行合并，否则会覆盖 DOM Testing Library 提供的默认查询集合。

RenderOptions.wrapper.summary.en:
Pass a React Component as the wrapper option to have it rendered around the inner element. This is most useful for creating
 reusable custom render functions for common data providers. See setup for examples.
RenderOptions.wrapper.summary.text:
传入一个 React 组件作为 wrapper 选项，使其渲染在内部元素的外层。这在为常见的数据提供者创建
 可复用的自定义渲染函数时最为有用。示例参见 setup。

SelectorMatcherOptions.collapseWhitespac.text: 请改为使用 normalizer 配合 getDefaultNormalizer

SelectorMatcherOptions.suggest.summary.en: suppress suggestions for a specific query

SelectorMatcherOptions.trim.summary.text: 请改为使用 normalizer 配合 getDefaultNormalizer

QueryMethod.summary.en: query methods have a common call signature. Only the return type differs.
QueryMethod.summary.text: 查询方法具有相同的调用签名，仅返回类型不同。

cleanup.summary.en: Cleanup elements rendered to the page and Preact trees that were mounted with render.
cleanup.summary.text: 清理渲染到页面上的元素，以及通过 render 挂载的 Preact 树。

render.summary.en: Render into the page. It should be used with cleanup.
render.summary.text: 渲染到页面中。应与 cleanup 配合使用。

renderHook.summary.en:
Allows you to render a hook within a test React component without having to
create that component yourself.
renderHook.summary.text:
允许你在测试用的 React 组件中渲染 hook，而无需
自己创建该组件。

waitSchedule.summary.en:
Wait for the next event loop.

It will be useful when you want to wait for the next event loop to finish.

 Please use `act` instead
waitSchedule.summary.text:
等待下一个事件循环。

当你想等待下一个事件循环完成时，这会很有用。

 请改用 `act`
